title: Permanent Account Number (PAN) — Instant e-PAN & Physical Reprint
official_portal_name: Income Tax e-Filing & Protean (NSDL) TIN Portal
verification_source: Income Tax Department e-Filing Rules & Protean/UTIITSL Fee Schedules
overview: Official procedures for obtaining a brand new Instant e-PAN digitally, or requesting a physical reprint of an existing PAN card in case of loss or damage.
eligibility: Instant e-PAN: Individual Indian residents who have never been allotted a PAN, possess an active Aadhaar card with a linked mobile number, and are not minors. Physical Reprint: Any existing PAN card holder whose PAN details are already linked with Aadhaar records.

fees.amount: Instant e-PAN: ₹0.00 (Free) | Physical Card Reprint: ₹50.00 (Dispatch within India)
fees.breakdown: Instant e-PAN is 100% paperless and free. Physical card reprint through Protean (NSDL) or UTIITSL costs ₹50.00 inclusive of GST and speed post delivery in India (₹959.00 for international delivery).
fees.payment_mode: Online payment via UPI, Debit Card, Credit Card, or Net Banking on Protean/UTIITSL portal.

timeline.dispatch: Instant e-PAN PDF is generated in real-time (usually within 10 to 30 minutes).
timeline.delivery: Physical reprint card is dispatched via India Post within 10 to 15 working days.

required_documents: For Instant e-PAN: 12-digit Aadhaar Number and Aadhaar-linked mobile phone (No physical documents required).
For Physical Reprint: Existing 10-character PAN number, 12-digit Aadhaar Number, and Date of Birth.
steps: To Get Instant New e-PAN (Free): Visit https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/fposervices/#/pre-login/instant-e-pan
Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number and agree to the validation terms.
Enter the OTP received on your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Validate Aadhaar demographic details (name, DOB, gender, photo) displayed on the screen.
Submit the request; you will receive an acknowledgement number to check status and download the signed PDF e-PAN.
To Order Physical Reprint of Lost PAN: Visit https://www.onlineservices.nsdl.com/paam/ReprintEPan.html (Protean) or https://www.pan.utiitsl.com/PAN_ONLINE/reprintpancard
Enter your 10-character PAN, Aadhaar number, and Date of Birth (MM/YYYY).
Authenticate using OTP sent to your registered mobile/email.
Pay the ₹50 official fee online and download the payment receipt.
warnings_and_fraud_prevention: Obtaining or possessing more than one PAN card is illegal under Section 272B of the Income Tax Act and attracts a penalty of ₹10,000.
Instant e-PAN only works for fresh applicants who never had a PAN allotted before; existing PAN holders who lost their card must use the Reprint facility.
Ensure your PAN and Aadhaar are linked to prevent your PAN from becoming inoperative.
checklist: Confirm whether you need a new PAN (Instant e-PAN) or a replacement (Reprint)
Have your 12-digit Aadhaar number and registered mobile phone active for OTP
If ordering physical reprint, keep your 10-character PAN number ready
Keep ₹50 payment method ready for physical dispatch
